blocks.text: Four Miss Grand International titleholders are coming together to share the stage at the 2026 pageant’s National Costume Competition and Preliminary Competition. Reigning queen Emma Tiglao will share hosting chores with her predecessors, fellow Filipino queen Christine Juliane “CJ” Opiaza from 2024, Luciana Fuster of Peru from 2023 and Isabella Menin of Brazil from 2022. This is the first time that the four international titleholders will be hosting together for the Miss Grand International pageant.
